newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, supplies tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, supplies tight.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed Thursday, with higher values in southeast locations because of a gradual increase in demand by the hog and catfish industries, dealers said.
Elsewhere, demand was light but supplies continued to be tight as flour mills reduced production. Light flour exports have flour mills operating at less than capacity, millfeed dealers said.
Flour mills were operating five to six days a week versus a normal six to seven days, several dealers said.
Millfeed prices have gradually slipped in Texas, where dealers said demand is in flux.
"We are in the quiet time, in between feeding seasons" said one dealer.
The winter feeding season is winding down, while it is too early to buy for summer feeding when pastures dry up.
